_comment: Manual URL overrides for events that don't have a hyperlink in the source doc. The build merges this with data/event-urls-from-doc.json — anything here is treated as 'human-verified, intentional'. NEVER add an unverified URL. Each value must be a real URL someone visited in a browser and confirmed.
_format: Keys are event numbers from the source doc (e.g. '31', '47'). Values are full URLs starting with https://.
